description: Activate the task flow and execute the first task in this repository (POKER-CORE-MODEL-001): implement immutable canonical domain types for cards, players, seats, positions, blind/ante configuration, chip amounts, streets, actions, pots, and table metadata, with serialization stability and explicit units.
acceptance_criteria: Card identity is unique and validated for a standard 52-card deck.
Chip/money values never use binary float for authoritative amounts.
Actions encode actor, street, action kind, amount semantics, sequence order, and source provenance.
Round-trip serialization is deterministic and versioned.

planning.title: Implement canonical cards, table, seats, stacks, and actions
